scope: Remove demonstrably unused legacy CSS selector branches only; no HTML, content, behavior or payload budget changes.

source.measurement: Source stylesheet gzip, not emitted-build size or page transfer.

method: Parse baseline HTML using parse5 and inventory actual class attributes from all 130 pages.

Lexically inventory full identifier tokens from Astro, Solid TSX, Vue, Svelte, TS/JS, server source, tests, runtime scripts and public SVG/JS; this conservatively retains classes mentioned even only by tests or inline CSS.

Remove only a selector with an absent directly required ClassSelector using CSS AST. A class inside :is(), :where(), :not() or other functional pseudo selectors is never considered required. Other selector branches, declarations, media contexts and cascade order are preserved.

Manually inspect dynamic class construction and Studio contract. Observed computed prefixes portal-status-, ka- and ki-from- are unrelated to removed classes; classList/conditional full tokens remain present. Studio accepts structural #main/tag/:nth-of-type selectors and bounded property editing, not arbitrary markup or class editing.
caveat: Lexical tokens alone cannot prove absence of every possible runtime string concatenation. Dynamic class expressions were inspected in addition to the 130-page baseline; integrated browser tests and emitted-build budget measurement remain separate root gates. Do not reapply this removal blindly after adding new templates or class-generating code.
